text_en: The word of the Lord came to me:
text_cn: 上主的话传给我说：

text_en: Mortal, prophesy, and say, Thus says the Lord God : Wail, “Alas for the day! ”
text_cn: “人子，你要讲预言说：吾主上主这样说：你们应悲哀；祸哉，那一日！

text_en: For a day is near, the day of the Lord is near; it will be a day of clouds, a time of doom for the nations.
text_cn: 因为那一日近了，上主的日子近了，那是密云的日子，是异民的终期。

text_en: A sword shall come upon Egypt, and anguish shall be in Ethiopia, when the slain fall in Egypt, and its wealth is carried away, and its foundations are torn down.
text_cn: 刀剑必临于埃及；伤亡者横卧在埃及时，恐怖必笼罩着雇士。她的财富必被抢去，她的基础必被拆毁。

text_en: Ethiopia, and Put, and Lud, and all Arabia, and Libya, and the people of the allied land shall fall with them by the sword.
text_cn: 雇士、普特、路得和一切杂族，利比亚和同他们结盟的本地人，都要丧身刀下。

text_en: Thus says the Lord : Those who support Egypt shall fall, and its proud might shall come down; from Migdol to Syene they shall fall within it by the sword, says the Lord God .
text_cn: 上主这样说：凡支持埃及的人都要丧亡，她骄傲的势力必要衰落，由米革多耳到色威乃的人，必丧身刀下 —— 吾主上主的断语 ——

text_en: They shall be desolated among other desolated countries, and their cities shall lie among cities laid waste.
text_cn: 她要在荒芜地带中，成为最荒芜的；她的城在荒废的城中，将成为最荒废的。

text_en: Then they shall know that I am the Lord , when I have set fire to Egypt, and all who help it are broken.
text_cn: 当我在埃及点火时，凡辅佐她的都要毁灭，那时他们便承认我是上主。

text_en: On that day, messengers shall go out from me in ships to terrify the unsuspecting Ethiopians; and anguish shall come upon them on the day of Egypt’s doom; for it is coming!
text_cn: 在那一日，我必派遣使者，乘着船，恐吓安居的雇士；恐怖必要笼罩他们，如埃及的日子。看，已来到了。

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : I will put an end to the hordes of Egypt, by the hand of King Nebuchadrezzar of Babylon.
text_cn: 吾主上主这样说：我要藉巴比伦王拿步高的手，消灭埃及的民众。

text_en: He and his people with him, the most terrible of the nations, shall be brought in to destroy the land; and they shall draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land with the slain.
text_cn: 他和跟他来的人民，是万民中最凶残的；他们被派来，是为破坏此地；他们将拔刀攻打埃及，使此地充满伤亡的人。

text_en: I will dry up the channels, and will sell the land into the hand of evildoers; I will bring desolation upon the land and everything in it by the hand of foreigners; I the Lord have spoken.
text_cn: 我要使河流成为干地，把此地卖给恶人，藉外人的手破坏此地和此地的一切：这是我，上主说的。

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : I will destroy the idols and put an end to the images in Memphis; there shall no longer be a prince in the land of Egypt; so I will put fear in the land of Egypt.
text_cn: 吾主上主这样说：我必要消灭偶像，使邪神由诺夫绝迹，由埃及再不出现王侯；使恐怖降在埃及地，

text_en: I will make Pathros a desolation, and will set fire to Zoan, and will execute acts of judgment on Thebes.
text_cn: 使帕特洛斯变为旷野，在左罕点火，对诺施行惩罚。

text_en: I will pour my wrath upon Pelusium, the stronghold of Egypt, and cut off the hordes of Thebes.
text_cn: 我要向新 —— 埃及的要塞，发泄我的怒气，铲除诺的民众。

text_en: I will set fire to Egypt; Pelusium shall be in great agony; Thebes shall be breached, and Memphis face adversaries by day.
text_cn: 我要在埃及点火，新必因恐怖而战栗，诺必被破坏，诺夫白日遭受敌人攻击。

text_en: The young men of On and of Pi-beseth shall fall by the sword; and the cities themselves shall go into captivity.
text_cn: 翁及丕贝色特的壮丁必丧身刀下，二城的人都要被掳去。

text_en: At Tehaphnehes the day shall be dark, when I break there the dominion of Egypt, and its proud might shall come to an end; the city shall be covered by a cloud, and its daughter-towns shall go into captivity.
text_cn: 当我在塔黑培乃斯打断埃及的权杖，消灭她骄傲的势力时，白日将变为黑暗，乌云笼罩着她，她的女儿也要被掳去。

text_en: Thus I will execute acts of judgment on Egypt. Then they shall know that I am the Lord .
text_cn: 当我对埃及施行惩罚时，他们必承认我是上主。”

text_en: In the eleventh year, in the first month, on the seventh day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me:
text_cn: 十一年一月初七日，上主的话传给我说：

text_en: Mortal, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; it has not been bound up for healing or wrapped with a bandage, so that it may become strong to wield the sword.
text_cn: “人子，我打断了埃及王法郎的臂膊，看，没有人包扎，没有人敷药，或用绷带裹起，使臂膊有力拿剑。

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God : I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, both the strong arm and the one that was broken; and I will make the sword fall from his hand.
text_cn: 为此，吾主上主这样说：看，我要打击埃及王法郎，打断他那还有力量的臂膊，使刀由他手中跌落。

text_en: I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and disperse them throughout the lands.
text_cn: 我要将埃及人分散到外邦，把他们散布在各地。

text_en: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put my sword in his hand; but I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and he will groan before him with the groans of one mortally wounded.
text_cn: 我必要加强巴比伦王的臂膊，把我的刀放在他手中；我要打断法郎的臂膊，使他在那人面前呻吟，像受伤的人呻吟一样。

text_en: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, but the arms of Pharaoh shall fall. And they shall know that I am the Lord , when I put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon. He shall stretch it out against the land of Egypt,
text_cn: 我要加强巴比伦王的臂膊，而法郎的臂膞反要衰弱；当我把我的刀交在巴比伦王手中，使他伸向埃及地时，他们便要承认我是上主。

text_en: and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them throughout the countries. Then they shall know that I am the Lord .
text_cn: 我要将埃及人分散到外邦，把他们散布在各地：如此，他们便要承认我是上主。”
